rows.grounds: Compound bāṇa-netra-indu-varṇaḥ (arrow, eye, moon, color/complexion); final -o reflects sandhi before following atra (token 1). Meaning grounded in compound elements; precise symbolic referents uncertain without wider context.
Sandhi form of atra after preceding -aḥ > -o; functions as locative adverb 'here' in the verse.
Compound mālā-mantraḥ (garland, mantra); final -o reflects sandhi before following token. Refers to a mantra in garland form.
Compound akhila-iṣṭa-daḥ (all/entire, desired, giver) with initial a- elided in sandhi; describes the mantra as granting all desired ends.
